rule.description: Any brace-enclosed branch whose condition is compile-time never-true (a `false` literal, a named constant initialized to `false`, or an unsigned comparison against the constant zero) can never execute; every value-namespace item reachable only through such branches — directly, or transitively through other such items, including trait-declared sink methods and their implementations — is runtime-shadowed dead code, and constants or statics left without any remaining reference are orphaned.

checks.description: Detect a brace-enclosed branch of an otherwise live function whose condition is provably never true at compile time, so the branch body cannot execute.
checks.detected_relation: live function -> branch guarded by a compile-time never-true condition
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The branch is the root of the dead surface: every unreachable item is reached from here, and the condition hides the unreachability from naive reference counting because the branch text still references its callees.

matches.evidence: Branch guarded by `SCRIPTING_EMIT_ROLLOUT`, a module constant whose initializer is the literal `false`; the branch calls the summary builder appended after the rendered listing. Reported at src/core.rs:110:12.
Branch guarded by `depth < LEGACY_SCRIPTING_DEPTH_CEILING` where the ceiling constant is zero and `depth` is unsigned, so the comparison is always false. Reported at src/display.rs:241:8.

measurement.never_true_reason: `display::LEGACY_SCRIPTING_DEPTH_CEILING` is zero and the left-hand side is unsigned

matches.evidence: Branch guarded by `SCRIPTING_ICON_FALLBACK`, a module constant whose initializer is the literal `false`; the branch returns a fixed glyph instead of falling through to the theme lookup. Reported at src/icon.rs:41:12.

checks.description: Detect an item whose every reference sits inside a compile-time never-true branch, so no runtime path can invoke it even though the source still contains the reference.
checks.detected_relation: never-true branch -> directly gated callee item
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The direct victims of the never-true gates: statically referenced (so ordinary unused-item detection stays quiet) yet unreachable at runtime, exactly the dead-code relation this case targets.

matches.evidence: Method referenced once, from inside the rollout branch of `Core::run`; 1 reference, 1 behind a never-true branch. Reported at src/core.rs:120:64.

Trait-declared method: referenced from the grid render hook (behind the zero-ceiling branch) and from the summary builder (itself gated); 2 references, 1 behind a never-true branch. Reported at src/display.rs:30:5.

Sink implementation method reachable only through the trait object built in gated code; 2 references (trait default-required + gated call sites resolving to it), 1 gated. Reported at src/display.rs:48:32.
Second sink implementation, constructed only by the parity pick inside gated code; 2 references, 1 gated. Reported at src/display.rs:58:32.
Boxed-constructor registry used by both gated callers; 2 references, 1 behind the zero-ceiling branch. Reported at src/display.rs:65:74.
Row-stream driver called from both gated callers; 2 references, 1 gated. Reported at src/display.rs:74:77.
Fixed-glyph lookup referenced from the gated branch of `Icons::get` and from the gated summary builder; 2 references, 1 gated. Reported at src/icon.rs:88:77.

checks.description: Detect an item with no reference from any live code at all — its only inbound edges come from items that are themselves unreachable, or it is a value-namespace item left with no references.
checks.detected_relation: shadowed item -> transitively or fully unreachable item (sink fanout, helper chains, orphaned members)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The tail of the dead surface: items whose liveness depends entirely on the shadowed network, including trait sink methods dispatched to via `dyn` objects built in unreachable code, so removing the gate-adjacent code alone leaves these behind unless reachability is traced to a fixed point.

excluded.structure: Impl blocks of foreign traits (Display, Ord, PartialOrd, Iterator, From, ...)
excluded.reason: The stock dead-code analysis never reports methods implementing a trait from another crate, so flagging them would not represent the targeted unreachable-at-runtime relation.

excluded.structure: Live sorter functions (by_name, by_size, by_date, by_version, by_extension, by_git_status) and the live icon theme lookup
excluded.reason: Reachable from live call paths; only the members reachable solely through the never-true surface are in scope.
Each constant still holds a textual reference (inside its never-true condition), so the item rule leaves them to the gate diagnosis; removing the gated branches removes their last reference.
